items.title: Apple's AI agent push: Why the pressure is mounting

items.title: Has AI's honeymoon ended on Wall Street?
items.summary: Although the AI industry has been the darling of Wall Street for years, the sector now makes investors wince as it reckons with a wave of concerns over dizzying spending and its promise to make the technology profitable.But as spending has ballooned, so has debt -- and profits have yet to match.

items.title: Tech sees huge sell-off as Anthropic IPO fails to lift the market
items.summary:
Deirdre Bosa discusses the AI trade falling apart as Wall Street sees widespread losses, Anthropic's (ANT) debut failing to boost markets, and the state of cybersecurity.

'Deirdre Bosa Live' airs every day at 4 p.m. Tune in daily to hear how the latest developments in AI and technology are reshaping companies, industries, and the global economy.

items.title: Shots Fired: Meta Will Reportedly Sell a $300 Muse Charm With Free Verizon 5G as Apple Builds Its Agent
items.summary: Key TakeawaysMeta reportedly plans to sell a $300 Muse Charm with up to 12 months of free Verizon 5G, and is targeting 10 million wearable sales in the second half of 2026. A connected device would let Meta reach users without Apple’s phones in between, just as Apple reportedly builds its own AI agent.
